dict.string: amanuensis records your microphone during meetings so you can transcribe them later. Transcription is on-device unless you configure a cloud engine.
amanuensis records system audio (the other side of your meetings) so you can transcribe them later. Transcription is on-device unless you configure a cloud engine.
amanuensis reads your calendar to name recordings after the meeting and, if you enable it, to start recording when a scheduled call begins. Calendar data never leaves the machine.
